text: Past Appeal Excerpt (WON): 'The denial based on insufficient conservative therapy duration is inappropriate because the patient presented with a progressive neurological deficit (new-onset foot drop, motor strength 3/5). Per UHC Clinical Policy Bulletin #2024-MSK-012, this constitutes a red-flag symptom that explicitly waives the 6-week conservative therapy requirement. Immediate MRI was medically necessary to rule out compressive myelopathy.'

text: Past Appeal Excerpt (WON): 'The classification of PBRT as investigational is inappropriate in this specific clinical context. The patient has significant cardiac comorbidities including prior myocarditis and a borderline LVEF. The comparative dosimetric plan shows photon therapy would result in a Mean Heart Dose of 4.8 Gy (posing a 35% excess relative risk of major coronary events per Darby et al., NEJM), compared to 0.3 Gy with PBRT. This extreme cardiac risk differential renders PBRT medically necessary and standard-of-care for this patient.'
